decisions.reason: Because this product is closely related to the firm's specialty wafer capabilities, management would likely tolerate uncertain early results and keep it unless it clearly falls below aspiration levels.

As an incremental extension of the core wafer business with an identifiable handling need, it is the kind of product an established German manufacturer would likely retain if performance is near aspiration.

The dedicated trade-fair launch signals strategic commitment, so under behavioral decision making the firm would likely keep it for another year while judging its still-uncertain results against aspirations.
A separate off-the-shelf brand is comparatively easy to discontinue if demand and visibility do not meet aspiration levels, allowing resources to be shifted back to core activities.

Because glass-based circuit boards stretch furthest from the established business and likely require more problemistic search, management would be more inclined to drop them if early market results stayed below aspirations.
